title: Advancing carbon dioxide capture: investigation into the kinetics and efficiency of absorption in molten calcium oxide–chloride
content:

DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00354C, Paper

The molten mixture of CaCl2 + CaO is capable of selective capture of CO2 with the absorption rate following almost exactly a novel kinetic model.
